description: This file contains functions and constants for handling internal runtime context delimiters, including escaping, stripping, and detecting internal context markers within text. It manages legacy and current internal context markers for the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: escapeInternalRuntimeContextDelimiters
methods.description: Replaces internal runtime context delimiters with escaped versions in a string.

methods.name: stripInternalRuntimeContext
methods.description: Removes internal runtime context markers and legacy context blocks from text.

methods.name: hasInternalRuntimeContext
methods.description: Checks if the text contains internal runtime context markers.
